statement:
∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (γ : ℝ → ℂ) (a b : ℝ),
  IntervalIntegrable (fun t => f (γ t) * deriv γ t) volume a b →
    cint f γ a b = ↑(∫ (t : ℝ) in a..b, (f (γ t) * deriv γ t).re) + ↑(∫ (t : ℝ) in a..b, (f (γ t) * deriv γ t).im) * I

universal.type: IntervalIntegrable (fun t => f (γ t) * deriv γ t) volume a b
universal.name: h
